summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Zayed University. It states that the university was founded in 1998 by the Emirati federal government and describes its admissions history: until 2008 it admitted only UAE national women, and after the Sweihan campus opened, a collaboration with the UAE Armed Forces, roughly 200 male students were admitted.
one_line: Zayed University, founded in 1998 by the Emirati federal government, expanded admissions to male students after 2008 via the Sweihan campus.
key_facts: Zayed University was established in 1998 by the Emirati federal government.
Until 2008, Zayed University accepted only UAE national women.
Zayed University admitted approximately 200 male students after the opening of the Sweihan campus.
The Sweihan campus was a collaboration between Zayed University and the UAE Armed Forces.
The admission of male students at Zayed University followed the opening of the Sweihan campus.
